large_scope_reason: This single targeted credential-integrity hotfix must enforce the provider boundary in both Accounts-owned Chat HTTP and the browser card, without breaking current credential encryption, revision, UUID replay, legacy BYOK, Graph or paid-outcome handling. It splits oversized existing React code by pure component extraction; the new Python and TypeScript helpers are intentionally small. Focused HTTP and Playwright coverage plus doc routing and exact-source evidence complete the narrow patch. All changes are stacked on the existing unmerged PR #282.
domains: Chat provider card and client-side key validation
HTTP and responsive browser regression acceptance
non_goals: No plaintext API keys, raw credential fingerprint, account passwords or auth tokens in Git/PR/screenshots.
No automatic cross-provider key migration, login bypass or user-controlled credential mutation outside authorized application API.
No change to live OpenRouter or DeepSeek provider origin, paid model traffic, retry strategy or budget.
No changes to production owner permissions, protected main, canonical PLAN or unrelated projects.
No global Docker, firewall, VPN, DNS or route setting changes, and no removal of QA databases.
Never weaken repository hygiene, existing tests, CSRF, encryption, rate limits, UUID replay or access checks.
